title: Unit Event — Find A Way Out — Episode8 Someday, Even If It's Not Soon

meta.Episode: Episode8 — Someday, Even If It's Not Soon
meta.Event Outline: Tis the season to be jolly and Vivid BAD SQUAD is all gathered at Weekend Garage. They discuss performing at the live house where RADder debuted, but Akito seems to have some history with said venue...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Wow...
I was thirstier than I realized.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's funny how it's sometimes hard to tell how you actually are... Anyway, where can I toss this...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? What are you all doing here...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You're kidding, right?
We were worried sick about you!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Sorry, Akito!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Whoa! Luka?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I was actually hiding in your pocket the entire time, but I never really got the opportunity to talk to you.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <When you decided to battle against those other performers, I rushed to find Toya...>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You did...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I apologize for making you do that, Luka, all of you. And thank you for going out of your way to find me.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <No, that's okay. I'm just glad to see that you're safe.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Also, you battled against those guys all by yourself, didn't you? You really made it out in one piece?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, I did fine.
They were nothing special in the end.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, we're trying to surpass RAD WEEKEND. I'm not gonna lose to the likes of them or let anything stop me from accomplishing that goal.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You're so strong, Shinonome...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: By the way, what were they like?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, so...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wow...
That really happened at Crawl Green?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: When Akito and I first teamed up, he kept getting badgered by all these prickly customers...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Now I realize that you've been dealing with their ilk for quite a long time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: To be fair, I wasn't exactly the most pleasant person to deal with at the time. I don't blame them for what happened.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I bit off more than I could chew. Plain and simple.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, if we do get to sing at Crawl Green, I promise to put on a performance that's going to floor everyone there.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'll be there with you! After all, we're teammates!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: She's right. I'll be right next to you as well. We can rewrite history, together.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, let's put on a show that totally erases what happened back then.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That'd be nice...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, let's go blow the roof off that place.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Oh, about our next event...
There's something I need to tell all of you...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Hey, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
There you are... Wait, huh?!
What are you guys doing here?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: A few different reasons...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Actually, Mita, sorry for ditching you back there. After making you tag along with me too...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: No, don't mind me. I mean, just now, you...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Well, you seem all better now, so that's good.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I am, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, about our next event...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Taiga said he'd come and watch.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is that true, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Taiga's really coming to see our event?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah!
That is, if we manage to book Crawl Green...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Uncle Taiga, huh...?
That means Arata and I have some work to do.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I bet Tono's gonna feel even more motivated after he hears this news.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm not worried about our motivation.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Me neither! I mean, this is probably the best Christmas present we could've asked for!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Uh, good for us...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Taiga's coming to see us...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: And I'm curious to find out just how far she can go if she's given that chance.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It'll be the first time he sees us perform after I started learning more about singing from him.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I need to do my best...
se_event_way_2022_004

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Become just like him, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
I really let my mouth run back there...
Now I'm starting to sound like Ken.
se_event_way_2022_004

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Ken, Taiga...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I have a feeling that the next generation of singers is going to help keep our dream alive...
se_event_way_2022_003
se_event_way_2022_003

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Wait, Akito, I thought you were done training!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No way, dude. I've still got some stuff left to do.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: My body's all warmed up, so now I've gotta get my voice ready.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, in that case, I'd like to join you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um, me too...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then, why don't we head over to the cafe? Dad just replaced all the equipment, which made singing that much more fun!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane and I got a chance earlier to test it all out!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, that's not a bad idea...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I agree. Also, I know it's getting late, but I'd like to join in if possible.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Of course you're welcome!
What about you Kotaro?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Th-Then, I'll go too!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Awesome! Oh, how about we...? Race to see who gets there first!

rows.Speaker: Kohane & Toya
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Okay.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Wait, we're gonna run?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: They sound pretty excited...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (We've got a long road ahead of us before we can surpass RAD WEEKEND. But...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Someday...
If that person's waiting for me beyond that gigantic hurdle...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm gonna succeed. No matter what it takes...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Akito, you coming?! You're gonna get left behind!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, wait up...!
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Once they get here, they all want to sing, huh?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Sounds like things went more or less smoothly.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: (I wasn't sure what would happen when I heard that Akito was going to battle someone... At the same time, I knew that he wouldn't do anything rash.)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Welcome.
Oh, hello...

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: It's been a while, Ken.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Yes, fancy seeing you here. What can I get for you?

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: Actually, it's about my place. It's not exactly a big deal, but this one kid's been badgering me about letting him and his friends host an event.

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: He keeps saying, “Our show will be better than the time RADder debuted. We promise to fill this place up and completely blow the roof off.”

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Ah, you must be talking about...

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line:
Yes, Arata Tono.
He mentioned that your daughter's team is a part of his group.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
I see...
I apologize if they've been causing you any trouble.

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line:
No, that's all fine.
If anything, I've been feeling a bit of nostalgia.

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line:
When RADder debuted...
When RAD WEEKEND happened...and became the stuff of legends...

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: And quite a lot of time has passed since what happened with Nagi...

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: A lot of teams have done events at my place, but none have been able to achieve the same sort of oneness that you guys did...

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: I've become convinced that I'll never get to see an event like that again.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Actually, you may be in for a bit of a surprise...

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: Haha. No one's going to top you, Taiga and Nagi. Speaking of, An's team... What's their name again? Vivid BAD SQUAD?

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: I know one of her teammates. He stank up the place a while back during this one event. I was planning on giving him a piece of my mind back then...

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: But I hear he's gotten a lot better lately.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: He has. I can vouch for him.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: He's improved quite a lot, and I suspect he's going to keep growing.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: He really has become a good singer.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: (Nagi, Taiga...)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: (We might just get a chance to see our dream come back to life in the near future...)
